content:
anya: Quick triage note  onboarding Hermes-7B (int4) shows weird summary quality drop after quant. Sharing repro & findings.

anya: Baseline fp16 ppl ~12.2, int4 after our calibrator ~12.8. But abstractive summarization ROUGE and length both down (~6 pts shorter outputs + repetitions).

mike: paste the conversion + quant config?

anya: conversion: kept original token ids, ran normalization NFKC, merged some unicode variants. quant config: `per_channel=true symmetric=false clip=99.9 calibrate_batches=256`.

sam: Hermes model note: proj layout is head-interleaved (k1,k2,k3,...), not contiguous blocks. Did loader assume block order? That breaks rotary/head align.

leslie: yep loader was reshaping to [num_heads, head_dim] with block offset ordering. If we don't permute, KV slices map to wrong heads -> rotary gets wrong phase.

anya: quick local test: swapped loader permutation to interleaved mapping and reran 100-sample eval. ppl -> 12.3, ROUGE recovered ~+5 pts (close to fp16).

mike: great. Also check token id collisions from normalization changes. Soft-hyphen and a zero-width char were mapped twice in conversion? That can poison prefix cache in long-context tasks.

anya: tokenmap histogram check found 2 duplicated ids (soft-hyphen U+00AD and U+2060 glue). Fixed mapping and re-ran -> small extra quality bump and fewer repeats.

ci-bot: CI: hermes-onboard/triage/1755555555 scheduled (calib + loader-permute + tokenmap-check). ETA 12m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: next steps: 1) add an assert in the conversion step to detect proj layout (shape heuristics + meta flag) and auto-apply permute; 2) add tokenmap dedupe histogram check as a smoke test; 3) re-run full eval suite (lm-evals + summarization + longctx cache test).

leslie: for the heuristic, check if weight shape matches [num_heads, head_dim * 3] vs [head_dim, num_heads*3] and/or known checkpoint attribute `proj_order`. If ambiguous, run both with small smoke and pick better ppl.

mike: I'll add the tokenmap histogram diff to the loader and a small fuzzy match report for normalization mismatches. Also add comment in PR about why rotary behaved badly (permute bug).

anya: PR created with loader fix + tokenmap check + unit test (small random seed smoke). Assigning to @mike for review.

mike: reviewing now, will push a minor cleanup and merge after CI green. Nice catch. :rocket:

anya: saved a bunch of debugging time. Adding note to onboarding checklist: "verify proj order + tokenmap dedupe".

sam: also add a quick eval in Optimize to flag int quantization regressions on customer-critical prompts.

leslie: agreed. We'll include a canary job that compares key metrics to a baseline model and blocks onboard if regression > threshold.

anya: thanks everyone, closing triage thread once CI passes.
